analyst_view.overall: Early view: Hearts have one point from three games and lost 3-1 at Thun with ten players injured, captain Stephen Kingsley going off hurt as well. Wouter Vrancken said a league game mattered more than the next European tie, a sign of where Hearts' priorities are. Borac beat KuPS at home but lost at Panathinaikos and Mjallby, and have lost 14 of their last 20 European away games.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals. Hearts have conceded seven in three European games and their defence is stretched by injuries, but Borac were muted after going behind at Mjallby and rarely score away. I stay with the estimate.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.9 corners, seven of them for Hearts. Hearts at Tynecastle should have territory against a Borac side that struggles away, so the split makes sense even with a weakened squad.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards. Borac started aggressively at Mjallby, but there is nothing on the referee yet, so I stay with the estimate.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.4 shots. Borac took several long-range shots early at Mjallby without testing the keeper, and Hearts should be on the front foot at home, so the estimate looks fair.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target. How many of Hearts' injured players return by December matters most here; until that is known I stay with the estimate.
